settings.curvature: exact local AD/force Schur/logdet volume Hessian; independently checked against dense AD and directional differences
settings.sampler: gradient-free Gaussian-reference pCN plus independent refresh, Metropolis-corrected full target

contraction.qualification: algebraically identical equations; contraction equivalence checked separately

fisher.qualification: independent full nonlinear marginal-target/proposal weight concentration; passing is not calibration or proof of adequate sampling

observed_hessian.qualification: independent full nonlinear marginal-target/proposal weight concentration; passing is not calibration or proof of adequate sampling

diagnostics.criteria: rank/folded split Rhat <1.01, bulk and tail ESS >=400, no frozen chains
diagnostics.limitation: Passing finite-chain diagnostics cannot exclude unvisited modes or establish model calibration.

scores.qualification: finite MCMC sample summary; usable only with adequate exploration; not repeated-case calibration

force_posterior.qualification: Rao-Blackwell mixture over finite exact-target MCMC trajectories; conditional on model and adequate chain exploration; not force calibration

qualification: Metropolis targets exact nonlinear marginalized-force density; observed curvature preconditions only. Neither local proposal ESS nor finite-chain diagnostics establishes global/posterior calibration.
